correctness.rationale: PASS: Congruence puts the old alternating matrix into J_(2r)⊕0_d, with unrestricted new coefficient matrices P (2×2r) and Q (2×d). The Schur residual [P J^{-1} P^T,Q;-Q^T,0] has rank 4 for rank Q=2, rank 2 for rank Q=1, and rank 0/2 for rank Q=0 according to symplectic orthogonality. Rank-Q counts are 1, (q+1)(q^d-1), (q^d-1)(q^d-q). Counting symplectically orthogonal row pairs gives U_r=q^(2r)+(q^(2r)-1)q^(2r-1) for r≥1 and U_0=1; the remaining P cases produce V and W exactly. Direct independent finite-field full enumerations for 12 small cases over F2,F3,F5 agree, and K_(2,2,2) F3 counts 1,1376,198288,331776. Character formula follows via odd-characteristic class-two central character orbit method; characteristic-two characters NOT claimed. Computational confirmations do not replace the all-field block proof.
